summary: The top of a page: breadcrumb, the page's h1, a description, the record's status, and the page's actions. Not a landmark — main is, named by this title.
useWhen: the top of every page inside the app shell — list pages, record pages, settings, wizards
the page has a title and actions that act on the whole page, such as New agent or Pause

useInstead.when: it is the bar across the top of the whole app, with the logo and the account menu
useInstead.why: Header is the banner landmark, rendered once by the shell. PageHeader is inside main and changes with each page

useInstead.when: it titles one section of a page rather than the page
useInstead.why: a Card's title is an h2 for a named region; a page has one PageHeader and one h1

useInstead.when: the page is empty or failed to load
useInstead.why: keep the PageHeader so the user still knows where they are, and put the EmptyState beneath it with headingLevel 2

composition.note: Slots, not children: `breadcrumb` above, `status` beside the title, `actions` at the end of the title row, and `children` as a row beneath for the page's Tabs or filters. Pass `titleId` and point `<main aria-labelledby>` at it.
composition.example: <main aria-labelledby="page-title"><PageHeader titleId="page-title" title="Payroll reconciler" description="Matches payroll exports against the ledger every night." breadcrumb={<Breadcrumb><BreadcrumbItem href="/agents">Agents</BreadcrumbItem><BreadcrumbItem isCurrent>Payroll reconciler</BreadcrumbItem></Breadcrumb>} status={<Badge intent="warning">Paused</Badge>} actions={<><MenuTrigger><Button variant="tertiary" aria-label="More actions" startIcon={<Icon as={Ellipsis} />} /><Menu onAction={run}><MenuItem key="delete">Delete…</MenuItem></Menu></MenuTrigger><Button variant="primary-brand">Resume</Button></>} /></main>

status.note: the record's state. Never an action, and never colour alone — a Badge carries its label

actions.note: most important last, so the primary action sits at the end of the row. One primary Button at most; beyond two or three actions, put the rest in a MenuTrigger

children.note: a row that belongs to the header: the page's own tabs, or the filters its table answers to

a11y.role: none — a <div>. The page's landmark is <main>, named by this title
guarantees: the title is a real heading, h1 by default, with a stable id for aria-labelledby
actions keep their DOM order when they wrap beneath the title on a narrow screen, so reading order matches visual order
notes: `headingLevel` is 1 by default. Use 2 only for a header on a pane that is not the page — the detail half of a list-detail layout, under the list's h1.
It is deliberately not a <header>: a <header> directly inside <body> is the banner, and the app shell's Header already is that.

antiPatterns.why: two h1s, and two answers to where am I. Sections below the header are Cards with h2 titles

antiPatterns.dont: dropping the PageHeader while the page loads or fails
antiPatterns.why: the user loses where they are exactly when something went wrong. Keep the title; put Skeleton or EmptyState beneath it

antiPatterns.dont: putting filters or a search field in `actions`
antiPatterns.why: actions act on the page; filters narrow what it shows. Filters go in `children`, the row beneath
a page has one next step. The one-primary-action lint rule counts them
